page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6e.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server deployed on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is equipped with a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor using the x86_64 architecture, providing 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 2 physical cores with 2 threads per core. System memory totals 8.0 GB, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio equivalent to 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware features include AVX-512 vector extensions and AVX512_VNNI instruction support. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps. The instance includes no attached local storage and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results highlight average single-core CPU execution alongside lower multi-core performance metrics. The instance achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1160.0 and a multi-core score of 2539.0. In stress-ng testing, single-core CPU throughput reaches 1312.8, while multi-core performance measures 3490.35. Memory bandwidth tests demonstrate 25.0 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 21.81 GB/sec for uncached writes. Database benchmarking via Redis SET operations yields 3.32 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput measures 3.78 GB/sec.

The 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio limits memory-intensive application execution, requiring external block storage for any persistent disk requirements. The dedicated hardware allocation ensures consistent execution without CPU credit throttles. This configuration aligns with entry-level compute tasks, microservice hosting, lightweight web serving, and basic CI/CD build environments.
